name: DuckStation GPL [anylinux]
description:
DuckStation is a high-performance PlayStation 1 (PS1/PSX) console emulator focused on playability, speed, and accuracy. It offers extensive visual enhancements to run vintage 32-bit PlayStation titles in stunning high resolution.

Features:
- Internal resolution upscaling up to 4K and 8K with widescreen rendering
- Texture filtering, true color rendering, and geometry precision correction (PGXP)
- Software, OpenGL, and Vulkan hardware-accelerated rendering backends
- Save states, fast-forwarding, rewind support, and cheat code integration
- Comprehensive controller configuration supporting analog sticks and rumble

This is an unofficial AnyLinux AppImage, which is able to work anywhere including glibc and musl. For more info: https://pkgforge-dev.github.io/Anylinux-AppImages/
